FidelAPIKeyCredential.title: Fidel API Key
FidelAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Copy a test or live secret API key from your Fidel Dashboard. Paste the key alone. NoClick sends it in the Fidel-Key header. Test keys access test data; live writes require a live key with the corresponding account permissions.
